web.description: Discover authenticated website accounts and contexts. Required with login when authenticated actions are supported; public-only sites may omit both. Copy real descriptors into invocation.session; never fabricate accounts.

Sign in through the website handler; never requests human interaction itself. Explain the step first. Copy an advertised auth item from attach/inspect; omit auth only for legacy services without methods. If saved accounts exist and the user has not named one, use ox.user.choose with account display names and Sign in manually, even for one account. Pass the choice as account: { $secret: key }; serviceID identifies the owner that can read it. Never request credentials in chat. The Host executes one handler step and returns authentication: unverified plus an optional bounded page observation. Use page.frames or browser.list({ includeFrames:true }) to select the document's matching service and fresh frameId for every login step, including the main document; attach that service first. page.document is observed only on the executing service’s domain and may be null. When observation is absent, loading, truncated, or insufficient, inspect ox.web.browser.getPageState with the destination document's fresh frameId. Do not restart at a provider homepage, replay rejected credentials, or repeat an unchanged screen. For a human step explain the instructions, then await ox.web.browser.showPage with the owning pageId. It waits for Done/Cancel and returns only status: completed or cancelled in the same execution and turn. After completed verify the intended account with fresh destination listSessions before dependent work. Stop after cancelled. The Host never verifies authentication, coordinates provider steps, or replays task writes.

account.description: Saved login reference { $secret: key } from ox.service.inspect secrets.

auth.description: Copy one advertised auth item from attach or inspect. Required when the service advertises auth; omit only for legacy services with unknown methods.

web.description: Optional read-only default website search. Scope and query syntax are website-specific; limits may be capped by the service. Reuse cursors with the same query and account. Null nextCursor does not prove completeness; failures are not empty results. Optional result data is service-specific.

api.description: Read credential configuration without prompting or contacting the API. Configured credentials are not verified server access.
Open Host-managed credential setup. Never request credentials in chat. Completion means configuration, not verified API access. Do not reopen after cancellation or replay writes.

mcp.description: Check server connectivity and authentication readiness without prompting or invoking tools. Connectivity is not tool authorization; errors are not absence.
Run the server's supported authorization flow through the Host. Available before tool discovery succeeds. Do not reopen after cancellation or replay writes.

ios.description: Read native permission state without prompting. OS permission is not account authentication.
Ask the user for the service's native OS permission through the Host. Do not reopen after cancellation or replay writes.
